description: Western Province - Amended Schedule 06 to the Order pertaining to delegation of powers in Western Provincial Public Service published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1950/47 of 21.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains to the amendment of an order regarding the delegation of powers for appointments, transfers, dismissals, and disciplinary control of officers in the Western Provincial Public Service. The content specifically deals with public service administration, including recruitment, transfers, and disciplinary matters within a provincial government structure, which aligns with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
